conflicts.fact: Where the sequence places fish/tilapia and what it says about external vs internal fertilisation, and where ovoviviparous classification is applied (tilapia-like mouthbrooder, guppy/shark) versus Lesson 7's simple classification
conflicts.versions: Lesson 1 sorts 'tilapia-like mouthbrooder note, shark/guppy' under internal fertilisation types, while Lessons 1 (Part A), 3 and 7 treat tilapia/fish as external fertilisers; Lesson 1 also lists tilapia in internal-fertilisation sorting.

conflicts.fact: Uterus structure: Lesson 2 predicts a cow's gestation as nine months and says the uterus is Y-shaped (rat/rabbit has two horns) while also saying humans have one chamber; Lesson 1 and 5 give cow gestation as 'months' / about 9 months
conflicts.versions: Lesson 2: 'Y-shaped uterus' in rat/rabbit vs 'two horns in a rat or rabbit'; a rabbit/rat has a duplex uterus, not Y-shaped.
Lesson 3: hen lays about one egg a day; Lesson 4: 'one egg every day or so' and 'one egg at a time' - roughly consistent but wording differs.

conflicts.fact: Pregnancy duration/cow cycle wording and cow ovulation
conflicts.versions: Lesson 4 says cows release one egg per cycle and humans one per month; Lesson 3 says 'cow usually' one; consistent but Lesson 4 Overview says 'women usually release one egg per month' while Learned says cows and humans one egg at a time.
